text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious,
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: The (angels who) snatch (the souls of the disbelievers) forcibly.
text_1989: The (angels who) snatch (the souls of the disbelievers) forcibly.
text_ref: The (angels who) snatch (the souls of the disbelievers) forcibly.

text_1981: And those who gently take (the souls of the believers) joyfully.
text_1989: And those who gently take (the souls of the believers) joyfully.
text_ref: And those who gently take (the souls of the believers) joyfully.

text_1981: By those (angels) who float downward.
text_1989: And those floating everywhere.
text_ref: And those floating everywhere.

text_1981: By those (angels) who are ever eager.
text_1989: Eagerly racing with one another—
text_ref: Eagerly racing with one another—

text_1981: To carry out the commands. . 6 The day will come when the quake will quake.
text_1989: to carry out various commands.
text_ref: to carry out various commands.

text_1981: The day the quake quakes.
text_1989: The day the quake quakes.
text_ref: The day the quake quakes.

text_1981: Followed by the inevitable. . 8 Some hearts, on that day, will be terrified.
text_1989: Followed by the second blow.
text_ref: Followed by the second blow.

text_1981: Certain minds will be terrified.
text_1989: Certain minds will be terrified.
text_ref: Certain minds will be terrified.

text_1981: Their eyes will be disgraced. . 10 They used to say, “Do we get recreated from the grave? 11. “After becoming rotten bones?” . 12 They said, “This is an impossible recurrence.”
text_1989: Their eyes will be subdued.
text_ref: Their eyes will be subdued.

text_1981: They will say, "We have been recreated from the grave!
text_1989: They will say, “We have been recreated from the grave!
text_ref: They will say, "We have been recreated from the grave!

text_1981: "How did this happen after we had turned into rotten bones?"
text_1989: “How did this happen after we had turned into rotten bones?”
text_ref: "How did this happen after we had turned into rotten bones?"

text_1981: They had said, "This is an impossible recurrence."
text_1989: They had said, “This is an impossible recurrence.”
text_ref: They had said, "This is an impossible recurrence."

text_1981: But it will take only one call.
text_1989: All it takes is one nudge.
text_ref: All it takes is one nudge.

text_1981: Whereupon they rise.
text_1989: Whereupon they get up.
text_ref: Whereupon they get up.

text_1981: Have you received the history of Moses?
text_1989: Have you known about the history of Moses? ft r
text_ref: Have you known about the history of Moses?

text_1981: His Lord called him in the sacred valley Tuwa.
text_1989: His Lord called him at the holy valley of Tuwaa.
text_ref: His Lord called him at the holy valley of Tuwaa.

text_1981: Go to Pharaoh; for he has transgressed.
text_1989: “Go to Pharaoh; he has transgressed.”
text_ref: "Go to Pharaoh; he has transgressed."

text_1981: Tell him, “Would you not purify yourself?
text_1989: Tell him, “Would you not reform? 584
text_ref: Tell him, "Would you not reform?

text_1981: “Let me guide you to your Lord.
text_1989: “Let me guide you to your Lord, that you may turn reverent?”
text_ref: "Let me guide you to your Lord, that you may turn reverent."

text_1981: He then showed him the great miracle.
text_1989: He then showed him the great miracle.
text_ref: He then showed him the great miracle.

text_1981: But he disbelieved and rebelled.
text_1989: But he disbelieved and rebelled.
text_ref: But he disbelieved and rebelled.

text_1981: Then he turned away in a hurry.
text_1989: Then he turned away in a hurry.
text_ref: Then he turned away in a hurry.

text_1981: And sent announcers to summon (the magicians). 24.
text_1989: He summoned and proclaimed.
text_ref: He summoned and proclaimed.

text_1981: He said, "I am your Lord; most high."
text_1989: He said, “I am your Lord; most high.”
text_ref: He said, "I am your Lord; most high."

text_1981: Consequently, GOD committed him to the retribution in the Hereafter, as well as in the first life.
text_1989: Consequently, GOD committed him as well as in the first life.
text_ref: Consequently, GOD committed him to the retribution in the Hereafter, as well as in the first life.

text_1981: This is a lesson for the reverent.
text_1989: This is a lesson for the reverent.
text_ref: This is a lesson for the reverent.

text_1981: Are you more difficult to create than the heaven that He built?
text_1989: Are you more difficult to create than the heaven? He constructed it.
text_ref: Are you more difficult to create than the heaven? He constructed it.

text_1981: He raised its masses and perfected it.
text_1989: He raised its masses, and perfected it.
text_ref: He raised its masses, and perfected it.

text_1981: He made its night dark and its morning visible.
text_1989: He made its night dark, and bright­ ened its morn.
text_ref: He made its night dark, and brightened its morn.

text_1981: He made the earth egg-shaped.*
footnote_1981: *79:30 The Arabic word "dahhaahaa" is derived from "Dahhyah" which means "egg."
text_1989: He made the earth egg-shaped.*
text_ref: He made the earth egg-shaped.*
footnote_ref: *79:30 The Arabic word "dahhaahaa" is derived from "Dahhyah" which means "egg."

text_1981: From it, He produced its own water and pasture.
text_1989: From it, He produced its own water and pasture.
text_ref: From it, He produced its own water and pasture.

text_1981: And He placed the mountains.
text_1989: He established the mountains.
text_ref: He established the mountains.

text_1981: And provisions for you and your animals.
text_1989: All this to provide life support for you and your animals.
text_ref: All this to provide life support for you and your animals.

text_1981: Then, when the great event comes to pass.
text_1989: Then, when the great blow comes.
text_ref: Then, when the great blow comes.

text_1981: The human being will remember everything he had done.
text_1989: That is the day when the human will remember everything he did.
text_ref: That is the day when the human will remember everything he did.

text_1981: Hell will be shown to everyone who sees.
text_1989: Hell will be brought into existence.
text_ref: Hell will be brought into existence.

text_1981: For the transgressor.
text_1989: As for the one who transgressed.
text_ref: As for the one who transgressed.

text_1981: Who preferred the first life.
text_1989: Who was preoccupied with this life.
text_ref: Who was preoccupied with this life.

text_1981: Hell will be the abode. 40.
text_1989: Hell will be the abode.
text_ref: Hell will be the abode.

text_1981: As for the one who reverenced the majesty of his Lord, and enjoined the self from sinful lusts.
text_1989: As for the one who reverenced the majesty of his Lord, and enjoined the self from sinful lusts.
text_ref: As for the one who reverenced the majesty of his Lord, and enjoined the self from sinful lusts.

text_1981: Heaven will be the abode.
text_1989: Paradise will be the abode. *'—
text_ref: Paradise will be the abode.

text_1981: They ask you about the Hour.
text_1989: They ask you about the Hour, and when it will take place!
text_ref: They ask you about the Hour, and when it will take place!

text_1981: You have no way of knowing it.
text_1989: It is not you (Muhammad) who is destined to announce its time.
text_ref: It is not you (Muhammad) who is destined to announce its time.

text_1981: Only your Lord controls its destiny.
text_1989: Your Lord decides its fate.
text_ref: Your Lord decides its fate.

text_1981: You only warn those who appreciate it. 46.
text_1989: Your mission is to warn those who expect it.
text_ref: Your mission is to warn those who expect it.

text_1981: The day they see it, they will feel as if they lasted one evening or half a day.
text_1989: The day they see it, they will feel as if they lasted one evening or half a day.
text_ref: The day they see it, they will feel as if they lasted one evening or half a day.
